dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……遅刻するよ……もぅ、うんしょっと」
dialogues.en: "......You'll be late...... hey."
dialogues.text: "......You'll be late...... hey."

dialogues.jp: ――ゴソゴソ。
dialogues.en: She's looking for something.
dialogues.text: She's looking for something.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「仕方ないなぁ、せぇの――」
dialogues.en: "I have no other choice......"
dialogues.text: "I have no other choice......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うりゃ！」
dialogues.en: "Wow!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!"

dialogues.jp: 身体を転がしてばっ、と起き上がる。
dialogues.en: I rolled my body and got up quickly.
dialogues.text: I rolled my body and got up quickly.

dialogues.jp: すでに条件反射というか、パブロフの犬状態。
dialogues.en: It was a conditioned reflex, like Pavlov's dog.
dialogues.text: It was a conditioned reflex, like Pavlov's dog.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、起きた起きた♪」
dialogues.en: "You're up!"
dialogues.text: "You're up!"

dialogues.jp:
ベッドに落とした国語辞典に手をついて、音夢
が笑う。
dialogues.en:
Nemu smiled as she leaned on the huge dictionary she dropped
on the bed.
dialogues.text:
Nemu smiled as she leaned on the huge dictionary she dropped
on the bed.

dialogues.en: "Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Nemu."

dialogues.jp: その元気そうな笑顔に驚く。
dialogues.en: It surprised me to see her so healthy and smiling.
dialogues.text: It surprised me to see her so healthy and smiling.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの、そんな幽霊を見たような顔して」
dialogues.en: "What? Why do you look like you saw a ghost?"
dialogues.text: "What? Why do you look like you saw a ghost?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いやだって……まさか、ほんとに幽霊じゃな
　いよな？」
dialogues.en: "You're not a ghost?"
dialogues.text: "You're not a ghost?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「失礼ですね。どんな夢を見てたんですか」
dialogues.en: "You're so rude. What kind of dream did you have?"
dialogues.text: "You're so rude. What kind of dream did you have?"

dialogues.jp: あんまりにも普段通りの音夢の｛にら／睨｝み。
dialogues.en: Nemu glared at me as usual.
dialogues.text: Nemu glared at me as usual.

dialogues.jp: なにもかもが元通りになった気がした。
dialogues.en: It felt like everything was back to normal.
dialogues.text: It felt like everything was back to normal.

dialogues.jp: 「良かった！」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god!"
dialogues.text: "Oh my god!"

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっと抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I held her tightly.
dialogues.text: I held her tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょ、ちょっとお兄ちゃん！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, hey. oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, hey. oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「良かった……」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god......"
dialogues.text: "Oh my god......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「は、恥ずかしいよ、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "You're embarrassing me, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "You're embarrassing me, oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
音夢の言葉に、何だか言いようのない違和感を
感じた。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ね、ちょっと痛いから離して……それに兄妹
　だしこういうのは」
dialogues.en:
"You're hurting me, let me go. You shouldn't be do this,
you're my brother."
dialogues.text:
"You're hurting me, let me go. You shouldn't be do this,
you're my brother."

dialogues.jp:
ぐっ、と力が抜けたところで音夢に押し離され
てしまった。
dialogues.en: Nemu pushed me back as I relaxed.
dialogues.text: Nemu pushed me back as I relaxed.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに？　本当におかしいよお兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "What? You're so wired, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "What? You're so wired, oniichan."

dialogues.jp: ……違和感の正体に、気づいた。

音夢が俺を呼ぶ時は兄さんだ。お兄ちゃんじゃ
ない。
dialogues.en: "Oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan?"

dialogues.en: Did I hear it right?
dialogues.text: Did I hear it right?

dialogues.jp: 心境の変化、なのかも知れない。
dialogues.en: Nemu seems like a completely different person.
dialogues.text: Nemu seems like a completely different person.

dialogues.jp:
元気になって心機一転。そういうことなのかも
知れない。
dialogues.en: "Yes. Here, you need to change soon or you'll be late."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Here, you need to change soon or you'll be late."

dialogues.jp: だけど、それを差し引いたとしても。
dialogues.en: Nemu tilted her head as she handed me my school uniform.
dialogues.text: Nemu tilted her head as she handed me my school uniform.

dialogues.jp:
俺には目の前の音夢が、まったくの別人のよう
に思えてならなかった。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほらほら、早く着替えないと遅刻しちゃうよ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, by the way, I don't need you to do that forehead thing
today. I know I'm not feeling well, so I'm not going to
school."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, by the way, I don't need you to do that forehead thing
today. I know I'm not feeling well, so I'm not going to
school."

dialogues.jp: 俺の胸に制服を預けて、音夢が首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: "......Forehead?"
dialogues.text: "......Forehead?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、それと、今日はおでこはいいからね。自
　分で体調良くないの分かるから休む」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Hey, what's wrong with you? Are you still asleep?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Hey, what's wrong with you? Are you still asleep?"

dialogues.jp: 胸を押さえる。
dialogues.en: I pressed my chest.
dialogues.text: I pressed my chest.

dialogues.jp: どうしてか、この中に音夢を感じない。
dialogues.en: I can't feel Nemu inside me for some reason.
dialogues.text: I can't feel Nemu inside me for some reason.

dialogues.jp:
たった一つの鼓動が、世界から取り残されたよ
うに小さく泣いている。
dialogues.en:
Only one heart's beating, making a small sound like it was
left from rest of the world.
dialogues.text:
Only one heart's beating, making a small sound like it was
left from rest of the world.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺も調子が悪いみたいだ」
dialogues.en: "No, I think I'm not feeling well either."
dialogues.text: "No, I think I'm not feeling well either."

dialogues.jp: 本当に吐き気がする。
dialogues.en: I feel like I'm going to throw up.
dialogues.text: I feel like I'm going to throw up.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうなの？　じゃあ、私が学園に連絡してお
　くから」
dialogues.en: "Really? Then I'll call the school."
dialogues.text: "Really? Then I'll call the school."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「待て音夢。連絡は俺がするからいいよ」
dialogues.en: "Wait, Nemu. I'll call the school."
dialogues.text: "Wait, Nemu. I'll call the school."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そう？　分かった。じゃあお願いします」
dialogues.en: "Really? Okay. Would you do that?"
dialogues.text: "Really? Okay. Would you do that?"

dialogues.jp: ｛あくび／欠伸｝をかみ殺して音夢が｛うなず／頷｝く。
dialogues.en: Nemu nodded as she stifled a yawn.
dialogues.text: Nemu nodded as she stifled a yawn.

dialogues.jp: なんとなく他人行儀に。
dialogues.en: She felt so distant.
dialogues.text: She felt so distant.

dialogues.jp: そうして部屋から出て行った。
dialogues.en: And she left my room.
dialogues.text: And she left my room.

dialogues.jp: ベッドに倒れこんだ。
dialogues.en: I fall into my bed.
dialogues.text: I fall into my bed.

dialogues.jp:
元通りに戻った気がした。だけど、それは間違
いだった。
dialogues.en: "She doesn't remember?"
dialogues.text: "She doesn't remember?"

dialogues.jp: 何かが違う。しかも決定的に。
dialogues.en: Or, was it all a dream to start out with?
dialogues.text: Or, was it all a dream to start out with?

dialogues.jp: 「何より……」
dialogues.en: It would be such an ironic dream, if it was a dream.
dialogues.text: It would be such an ironic dream, if it was a dream.

dialogues.jp: 「……俺とのことを忘れてる」
dialogues.en: But I know what happened so far isn't a dream.
dialogues.text: But I know what happened so far isn't a dream.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりが恋人だったことを、今の音夢は知らな
いだろうと思う。
dialogues.en:
I saw the broken branch on the cherry tree. Sakura isn't
coming into my room from it.
dialogues.text:
I saw the broken branch on the cherry tree. Sakura isn't
coming into my room from it.

dialogues.jp: 全てが夢だったのか。
dialogues.en:
And I could still smell the fragrance of Nemu and the cherry
blossom in my bed.
dialogues.text:
And I could still smell the fragrance of Nemu and the cherry
blossom in my bed.

dialogues.jp: ◆元気な音夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Healthy Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Healthy Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
朝、音夢に起こされた――当たり前のことだが、
まるで普段どおり元気な様子に驚いてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Nemu woke me up in the morning. It's the usual routine, but
it surprised me to see her so healthy like before.
dialogues.text:
Nemu woke me up in the morning. It's the usual routine, but
it surprised me to see her so healthy like before.

dialogues.jp:
喜んで音夢に抱きつくが、なぜか兄妹でそんな
ことをしてはいけないと言われてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I hugged her feeling really happy, but she told me we
shouldn't do that because we're brother and sister.
dialogues.text:
I hugged her feeling really happy, but she told me we
shouldn't do that because we're brother and sister.

dialogues.jp:
｛あぜん／唖然｝とするしかなかった。明らかに、音夢は俺
のことを好きで愛し合っていた時間を忘れてい
るようだった――。
dialogues.en:
It shocked me. It was so obvious that she completely forgot
about the time she loved me and we were together.
dialogues.text:
It shocked me. It was so obvious that she completely forgot
about the time she loved me and we were together.
